updates.charges: Breach of the peace while accompanying the William Moore memorial march in Alabama
updates.sentence: Arrested May 3, 1963 after crossing the Georgia-Alabama border while accompanying the William Moore memorial march. Released from jail on $300 bond on May 4. The subsequent court disposition is unverified. This is separate from his 1961 Freedom Ride arrest.

entries.rationale: NYT May6,1963 UPI dispatch dated FtPayne May5, original PDFpage16 visually verified: names McNair and Forman arrested Friday, released last night. May3-May4 exact. Existing1961case preserved.

entries.name: Pablo "Yoruba" Guzmán

expected_cases.charges: Arrests in Young Lords direct actions (New York City, 1969–70)

updates.convicted: Convicted; two concurrent two-year terms imposed
updates.sentence: Began serving two concurrent two-year federal sentences on May 30, 1973. Guzman later recalled serving nine months in 1973-74, including initial confinement in several institutions and imprisonment at Tallahassee. The precise release day and month remain unverified; 1974 is year precision. This is separate from his 1969-70 Young Lords arrests.

entries.rationale: First-person Mi Libro explicitly describes immediate sentence and handcuffing May 30, 1973; Senate report p8 corroborates final sentencing. Brother Ray reports nine months actually served in 1973-74. The live application preserves documented months without manufacturing an exact day total. Release month and day remain unverified.
